profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Cognizant | BU Comp Sci 21'
profile.summary: Athlete, Artist, Programmer. Building and maintaining software to help drive the future.

positions.title: Unity Developer
positions.description: During this externship program with XR Terra I learned the foundations of Unity and C# for developing 2D, 3D, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality projects. I then applied these skills by working on a VR crane training simulator for Packet39, and an industrial training AR project for PTC which was covered under an NDA.

positions.title: Campus Ambassador
positions.description: Selected to represent Dell at Boston University, sharing my positive summer internship experiences and helping attract other Computer Science students to the company.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked as a software engineer on the runtime element team. Developed a Python script for detaching cloud attachments from training accounts to free up large amounts of AWS storage, reducing storage costs. Created an FDF web app that allows an AWS user to delete any duplicate files found in their account. Fixed a customer facing bug within a large production codebase in Bitbucket. Participated in grooming, design, and stand-up meetings with my team of developers and quality assurers in accordance with the Agile software development system.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on a variety of projects incorporating integration, and interface design. Including a dashboard to display user data of any single account within the companies records. Collaborated on a “Greenlight” mini-hackathon where we designed a new homepage for the three PaaS the company sells. Worked with CSS, HTML, and the company’s unique platform for creating web apps “Boomi Flow”.
